customer_message: My lightning cable only charges my phone when I hold the cable at a weird 45-degree angle. Is my charging port broken?

customer_message: My iPhone says 'No SIM' even though my Verizon nano-SIM is firmly inserted in the tray.

customer_message: Does Apple replace batteries on older iPhone 6s models in store?
reference_reply: Yes! Apple Stores and Authorized Service Providers still offer battery replacements for eligible models. Details: https://support.apple.com/iphone/repair/battery-replacement

customer_message: The rear camera on my iPhone 12 shakes uncontrollably and buzzes like a bumblebee when taking photos.
reference_reply: That shaking sound points to the optical stabilization sensor. Please DM us your serial number to book a repair.

customer_message: My Apple Watch Series 6 back sensor glass cracked while putting it on the magnetic charger.
reference_reply: We want to make sure you stay safe and get that repaired. DM us to review your AppleCare+ coverage and service options.

customer_message: Is wireless charging supported on the standard iPhone 8?
reference_reply: Yes, iPhone 8 supports Qi-certified wireless charging pads. More info here: https://support.apple.com/HT208078

customer_message: My Mac keyboard spacebar is stuck and typing double spaces on every keystroke.
reference_reply: We can help with recurring spacebar inputs. Please DM us your Mac model so we can check eligibility for keyboard service.

customer_message: Can I use an Apple 20W USB-C power adapter with my older iPad mini 4?
reference_reply: Yes, you can safely use the 20W USB-C adapter with an appropriate Lightning cable. See details: https://support.apple.com/HT202105

customer_message: My iPhone vibrates violently for 3 seconds then completely shuts down.
reference_reply: This behavior requires an in-depth hardware diagnostic. Please DM us your device model and iOS version.

customer_message: How do I safely clean dust out of my iPhone speaker grilles?
reference_reply: Use a soft, clean, dry small-bristled brush to gently remove debris. Detailed cleaning instructions: https://support.apple.com/HT207123

customer_message: My iPhone screen has a bright yellow tint across the entire display compared to my wife's phone.
reference_reply: Check if True Tone or Night Shift is enabled in Settings > Display & Brightness. Here is how: https://support.apple.com/HT207570

customer_message: The mute toggle slider on the side of my iPhone fell off completely.
reference_reply: We can help you arrange an appointment to replace or repair that switch. DM us to get started.

customer_message: My iPad headphone jack has the broken metal tip of an AUX cable stuck deep inside it.
reference_reply: We strongly advise having an Apple technician extract lodged audio pins to avoid port damage. DM us to set up a visit.

customer_message: Does water damage get covered under standard one-year Apple limited warranty?
reference_reply: Liquid damage is not covered under the Apple One-Year Limited Warranty, but is covered under AppleCare+. More info: https://support.apple.com/HT204104

customer_message: My MacBook MagSafe charger light remains solid dark green and won't turn amber to charge.
reference_reply: Try resetting the SMC on your Mac and checking the magnetic pins. Follow this guide: https://support.apple.com/HT201295

customer_message: Both internal fans on my 16-inch MacBook Pro sound like a jet engine even with zero apps running.
reference_reply: Check Activity Monitor for high CPU processes like Spotlight indexing, and reset the SMC: https://support.apple.com/HT202179

customer_message: My iPhone microphone doesn't pick up my voice during regular cell calls, only on speakerphone.
reference_reply: Test your primary microphone using the Voice Memos app. Here are full troubleshooting steps: https://support.apple.com/HT203792

customer_message: I smell an electrical burning smell coming from the ventilation exhaust of my iMac.
reference_reply: Please power off and unplug the iMac immediately from the wall outlet. DM us right away with your phone number.

customer_message: The haptic Taptic Engine on my iPhone 13 makes an ungodly loud mechanical buzzing sound instead of a soft tap.
reference_reply: A loud buzz from the Taptic Engine indicates loose mounting or hardware failure. DM us to set up service.

customer_message: Can I replace the battery in my Magic Mouse 2?
reference_reply: Magic Mouse 2 features a built-in rechargeable battery and cannot be user-replaced. Charge via Lightning: https://support.apple.com/HT205364

customer_message: My iPhone screen turns unresponsive to touch randomly in the middle third of the screen.
reference_reply: A dead zone on the digitizer requires an inspection. Send us a DM so we can verify warranty and book a diagnostic.

customer_message: Is the back glass on an iPhone 12 replaceable separately from the whole unit?
reference_reply: Depending on the exact model and technician diagnostic, rear system repairs may be available. Review repair pricing here: https://support.apple.com/iphone/repair

customer_message: My AirPods Pro case hinge is completely loose and wobbly, feels like it's snapping off.
reference_reply: We can help look into case replacement options. DM us your serial number to review coverage.

customer_message: Why does my iPhone battery health show 94% after 6 months of use?
reference_reply: Battery capacity naturally degrades with chemical aging. A drop to 94% over 6 months is completely normal! Learn more: https://support.apple.com/HT208387

customer_message: Ever since updating to iOS 17.2, my Messages app crashes instantly every single time I tap on a group chat.
reference_reply: We'd like to help fix that crash. Try force closing Messages and performing a force restart: https://support.apple.com/HT201559

customer_message: My iPhone is stuck in a boot loop showing the white Apple logo flashing on and off endlessly after an interrupted software update.
reference_reply: Let's get your phone back up and running using Recovery Mode with a computer: https://support.apple.com/HT201263

customer_message: I cannot update to iOS 16 because it says 'Unable to Verify Update - An error occurred verifying iOS 16'.
reference_reply: Try deleting the downloaded update file in Settings > General > iPhone Storage, then re-download it over a stable Wi-Fi network: https://support.apple.com/HT201435

customer_message: The keyboard typing sounds are blaring at 100% volume even when my ringer volume is set to minimum.
reference_reply: You can toggle Keyboard Clicks off and on in Settings > Sounds & Haptics, followed by a quick restart: https://support.apple.com/HT208248

customer_message: After updating my MacBook to macOS Sonoma, my Wi-Fi disconnects every 5 minutes and drops IP address.
reference_reply: Let's test removing your known Wi-Fi network and renewing the DHCP lease in Network Settings: https://support.apple.com/HT202222

customer_message: My iPad screen is completely frozen on the home screen and won't respond to any swipes or button presses.
reference_reply: A forced restart will usually resolve this freeze immediately. Follow these steps: https://support.apple.com/HT210631

customer_message: Bluetooth toggle is greyed out in Control Center and Settings on my iPhone 12.
reference_reply: If Bluetooth remains greyed out after restarting, it may indicate a hardware component fault. DM us to run remote diagnostics.

customer_message: Why does iOS 'System Data' take up 95 GB of my 128 GB storage?
reference_reply: System Data includes cached logs and Siri voices. Syncing with a computer often clears out stale cache files: https://support.apple.com/HT201656

customer_message: My photos app has been stuck on 'Restoring from iCloud... 1 item remaining' for three weeks.
reference_reply: Make sure Low Power Mode is off, connect to Wi-Fi and power overnight. See troubleshooting steps: https://support.apple.com/HT204264

customer_message: Safari crashes every time I try to open a private browsing tab on iOS 16.4.
reference_reply: Try clearing Safari cache in Settings > Safari > Clear History and Website Data, then test again: https://support.apple.com/HT201265

customer_message: The latest watchOS update bricked my Series 5 into a red exclamation mark screen.
reference_reply: A red exclamation mark on Apple Watch requires mail-in service. DM us your watch details to create a service box request.

customer_message: My phone won't ring for incoming calls, it goes directly to voicemail without lighting up.
reference_reply: Check if 'Silence Unknown Callers' or a Focus mode like Do Not Disturb is enabled in Settings: https://support.apple.com/HT207354

customer_message: AirDrop won't discover any nearby devices even when set to 'Everyone for 10 Minutes'.
reference_reply: Ensure Personal Hotspot is turned off, as it disables AirDrop. Steps here: https://support.apple.com/HT204144

customer_message: My iPhone screen auto-lock setting is permanently locked at 30 seconds and greyed out.
reference_reply: When Low Power Mode is on, Auto-Lock is restricted to 30 seconds to save battery. Turn it off in Settings > Battery: https://support.apple.com/HT204904

customer_message: CarPlay keeps crashing and restarting every time Google Maps announces a turn.
reference_reply: Try forgetting the car in Settings > General > CarPlay, updating your navigation apps, and reconnecting: https://support.apple.com/HT210892
